lines.t: Every breath, I give you thanks
Yahushua, your name remains
Every breath, I give you thanks
Every word, I lift your name

Yeah, who's true? All I have returns to you in praise for the life within my lungs, for the mercy I receive, for the kindness never ending, for the truth I believe, for each moment you have given, for the path before my feet, for your voice that gently guides me, for your presence full and complete.
All I am, I offer now, let my gratitude resound.
Giving thanks to Yahushua, with every word I say.
Your worship rising up, in every moment of my day.
Giving thanks to Yahushua
Let my heart remain
Focused only on your name
Forever I will give you praise
For the peace within my spirit
For the strength to stand each day
For the wisdom you provide me
In every step I take
For the grace that covers fully
For the love that never ends
For your hand that stays upon me
Faithful one, my closest friend
All I am, I offer now
Let my gratitude resound
Giving thanks to Yahushua
With every word I say
Your worship rising up
In every moment of my day
Giving thanks to Yahushua
Let my heart remain
Focused only on your name
Forever I will give you praise
Thank you for every promise
Thank you for all you've done
Thank you for who you are. Eternal, holy one.
Giving thanks
With every breath
Yahushua
